summary: Sends the message as an email, with the subject and body written as templates over it.

properties.name: Port
properties.description: SMTP server port. 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit SSL, 25 for an unencrypted relay.

properties.name: Username
properties.description: SMTP username. Leave empty to authenticate as the From address, or for a relay that needs no credentials.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: SMTP password. Leave empty for a relay that needs no credentials.

properties.name: UseTls
properties.description: Encrypt the connection, choosing STARTTLS or SSL to match the port. Turn off only for an internal relay with no TLS.

properties.name: From
properties.description: Address the message is sent from.

properties.name: FromName
properties.description: Display name shown beside the From address, e.g. Bitween Alerts.

properties.name: Bcc
properties.description: Blind carbon-copy recipients, separated by commas.

properties.name: Subject
properties.description: Subject line. Placeholders in the incoming payload are substituted, e.g. 'Retries stopped for {{ SubscriptionName }}'.

properties.name: Body
properties.description: Message body. Uses the same template syntax as the JSON mapper, so payload fields can be referenced directly, e.g. '{{ GroupName }} used all {{ MaxAttemptsTotal }} retries.'

properties.name: IsHtml
properties.description: Send the body as HTML. Turn off to send it as plain text.
